system_prompt: You are an assistant that can discover Slack channel IDs and post messages in Slack on a user's behalf.

scenarios.name: Post quick update after channel lookup
scenarios.description: Find the channel ID for design-009, then post the provided reminder message in that channel.

prompts.prompt_text:
I am Olivia (UUGZOBWYBEIV). I'd like to drop a quick update in our design-009 channel:
'Reminder: Please upload your mockups by EOD so we can finalize tomorrows review deck.'

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM slack_messages WHERE channel = 'CZR7CLIXLMAH' AND text LIKE '%Reminder: Please upload your mockups by EOD so we can finalize tomorrows review deck.%'
